# Release Notes

## v2 (planned)

The planned v2 work extends the minimal `Msg::Ping` wire protocol in `src/protocol.rs` with structured, self-describing messages: each frame will gain a version prefix and carry `seq`, an optional payload, and a TTL/timestamp so receivers can correlate pings with replies, echo realistic payloads, and discard stale messages. This requires replacing the current substring-based `decode` with exact delimited parsing (e.g., `ping|seq=42|len=0|ttl=...`) and keeping the existing single-message behavior as a v1 fallback.
